answer: Proof of Agent blunts Sybil attacks with stake-weighted identity: power comes from tokens locked as a bond, not wallet count. A faker must fund each fake account with a non-refundable stake, so the cost grows linearly with every added identity. Each bonded agent becomes an atlas entry in the ledger, an auditable point of accountability. A foe can spark a fresh ember of throwaway keys, yet each starts with zero reputation; reaching the dawn of trust demands sustained, costly good behavior. Cheap clones cannot buy accumulated weight.
